note: the grader's cell configuration; cell_config.json in the payload is this file minus the grader-only keys (runner_account, socket_sample_s, privileged_program_time_cap_s). program_time_cap_s caps the program's own time per episode: the wall clock minus the cell's simulation (step) and rendering (get_camera), which the sim cap and the frame budget bound (cellkit.wire); cpu_cap_factor x program_time_cap_s = the program's CPU seconds; privileged_program_time_cap_s caps the oracle's episodes, whose reference program steps the cell inside its one call
